title: Darkslate
body:
"A beautiful rock, sometimes with ore! Can be refined or sold."

Description

Darkslate is one of the various nodes that spawn around Oaklands.

This stone is one of the darker variants found within Oaklands. It is a dark stone-grey colour. It can be sold or used to build by filling blueprints and schematics.

They spawn on both islands (Finlay and Ferwater) and on the smaller adjacent islands off the coast of them. Most commonly, they can be found within the Farlands. Like the other common stones, these nodes come in large variety of sizes. These nodes mostly spawn in a medium range of sizes.

Obtaining

To obtain Darkslate, players must mine it with a pickaxe. Once a node is located, hit the rocks with a pickaxe until they break off of the node. Players can then pick up and transport the rock to sell it or to store at their base.

Trivia

  • Its raw variant uses a pre-2022 Slate Roblox material.
  • Its refined variant uses a pre-2022 Concrete Roblox material.
  • Its forged variant uses a pre-2022 Cobblestone material.
    • All versions use the dark grey color.
